nodes.label: Definable Selector Setup
nodes.statement: Fix a parameter-free K-formula theta(x_bar), or declared parameters p_bar transported by h. S_theta(D,p_bar) is the set of tuples satisfying theta. The claimed relations are internal to the complete K-structure and independently physically grounded; analyst-only labels are excluded.
nodes.domain: One admitted actual token P, interval I, complete many-sorted signature K, D_ontic,K(P), Phi_K(P), C1 isomorphism h; correctly sorted tuples and fixed/transported parameters. Formula selection is internal to K and physically grounded separately.
nodes.scope: One admitted actual token P, interval I, complete many-sorted signature K, D_ontic,K(P), Phi_K(P), C1 isomorphism h; correctly sorted tuples and fixed/transported parameters. Formula selection is internal to K and physically grounded separately.
nodes.proof: Definition plus physical-grounding obligation; no claim that theta denotes mineness.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Arbitrary complete-type projections, frozen external labels and omitted relations do not satisfy this internal-selector contract. Definability alone does not establish semantic correctness.

formal_contract_R157.object_domain: One admitted actual token P, interval I, complete many-sorted signature K, D_ontic,K(P), Phi_K(P), C1 isomorphism h; correctly sorted tuples and fixed/transported parameters. Formula selection is internal to K and physically grounded separately.
formal_contract_R157.quantifiers: Fixed P,I,K and declared parameters per instance. Formula quantifiers range over the correctly sorted carriers of that instance. Semantic vocabulary outside K is never silently quantified as a K-relation.
formal_contract_R157.bearer_time_signature: Same actual bearer token, interval, complete K, formula and parameter transport throughout one T1 instance.
formal_contract_R157.purpose: Locate the exact conditional step from actual body-centered organization to an experiential substructure, while keeping mineness semantics and measurement explicit.

nodes.label: Coordinate Transport
nodes.statement: For every K-formula theta and correctly sorted tuple a_bar, D |= theta(a_bar,p_bar) iff Phi |= theta(h(a_bar),h(p_bar)); hence h[S_theta(D,p_bar)]=S_theta(Phi,h(p_bar)).
nodes.domain: One admitted actual token P, interval I, complete many-sorted signature K, D_ontic,K(P), Phi_K(P), C1 isomorphism h; correctly sorted tuples and fixed/transported parameters. Formula selection is internal to K and physically grounded separately.
nodes.scope: One admitted actual token P, interval I, complete many-sorted signature K, D_ontic,K(P), Phi_K(P), C1 isomorphism h; correctly sorted tuples and fixed/transported parameters. Formula selection is internal to K and physically grounded separately.
nodes.proof: Induction on formulas: K-isomorphism preserves/refects atomic formulas and equality; Boolean cases follow; existential witnesses map by h and return by surjectivity; universal follows; tuplewise equivalence yields set equality.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Standard isomorphism preservation. Tokenwise and K-relative; no empirical identification of h, complete-signature validation or mineness semantics.

nodes.label: Semantic Vocabulary Setup
nodes.statement: Let L be a semantic vocabulary outside K containing the expression felt bodily mineness. Metalinguistic assignments nu interpret L without changing D,Phi,h,theta or any K-fact.

Formula selection is internal to K and physically grounded separately. L and nu are metalinguistic, not new relations in K.

nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: If the mineness predicate is explicitly added to complete K with independently fixed interpretation, this setup changes; its physical/semantic grounding must then be supplied rather than assumed.

nodes.label: Semantic Residual
nodes.statement: A:C1 plus a K-definable transported coordinate does not uniquely determine which external L-name denotes that experiential substructure. In particular, the name felt bodily mineness requires an additional fixed bridge B_min.
nodes.domain: One admitted actual token P, interval I, complete many-sorted signature K, D_ontic,K(P), Phi_K(P), C1 isomorphism h; correctly sorted tuples and fixed/transported parameters. Formula selection is internal to K and physically grounded separately. Same K-structure and experiential structure; only L-assignments differ.

nodes.proof: Keep D,Phi,h,theta and the transported support fixed. One nu names it felt bodily mineness; another names it only body-related experiential role and leaves the former undefined or separately assigned. Both preserve every K-fact, so uniqueness is not entailed.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: This does not assign different experiences to identical complete organization. It varies metalinguistic interpretation only; it does not show all names are equally empirically adequate.

nodes.label: Report Domain Setup
nodes.statement: Let Omega=Omega_rep union Omega_norep include admitted actual tokens with and without a typed report channel. An operational report measure M_rep has domain Omega_rep because its protocol requires that channel.
nodes.domain: Mixed declared actual domain Omega; report protocol and channel typing fixed. Omega_norep is nonempty for the coverage witness.
nodes.scope: Mixed declared actual domain Omega; report protocol and channel typing fixed. Omega_norep is nonempty for the coverage witness.
nodes.proof: Definition of a partial operational measure.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A structural predicate ReportPresent can be total and false outside Omega_rep; that is not the same object as executing the partial measurement protocol.

nodes.label: Report Coverage Limit
nodes.statement: M_rep alone cannot evaluate a target quantified over all Omega. Every total extension requires separately assigned values on Omega_norep; assigning no report to no mineness is an extra rule, not a consequence of the partial measure, A:C1 or A:U1.
nodes.domain: Exactly R157:REPORT_DOMAIN_SETUP; mathematical conclusion concerns the partial map. C1/U1 are interpretation context, not premises needed for the set-theoretic domain fact.
nodes.scope: Exactly R157:REPORT_DOMAIN_SETUP; mathematical conclusion concerns the partial map. C1/U1 are interpretation context, not premises needed for the set-theoretic domain fact.
nodes.proof: M_rep is undefined outside Omega_rep. A total function on Omega must add values there; at least two Boolean extensions agree on Omega_rep and differ on a nonreporter. The partial map does not choose between them.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Does not assert or deny bodily mineness for nonreporters. A report-based bridge may be valid on Omega_rep; universal extension remains additional.

nodes.label: Mineness Bridge Schema
nodes.statement: A candidate B_min must jointly specify: grounded theta_body; T1 transport; independently fixed target semantics; common bearer/body/time/signature/operation domain; separate fallible measurement; and explicit failure criteria. Missing report is not target absence. The candidate theta_body conjunction uses attachment, body-directed sensory routing, body-directed action-consequence routing and installed attribution use; interoception, affect and persistence are named optional extensions.
nodes.domain: Candidate selected bodily-mineness interpretation on a declared actual domain. This is not a basal-experience gate or a proved necessary/sufficient condition.
nodes.scope: Candidate selected bodily-mineness interpretation on a declared actual domain. This is not a basal-experience gate or a proved necessary/sufficient condition.
nodes.proof: Obligation/schema only. B:BAC supplies admissibility requirements; T1 supplies structural transport but not the semantic or empirical premises.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: No proof that theta_body is complete, necessary, sufficient or realized biologically. A fiber counterexample with independently warranted F_O would refute sufficiency on that domain.
